name: Moonraker FilaMan
description: Driver that sends spool assignments from FilaMan to Moonraker's filaman component. Supports toolhead assignment and optional macro-based tray targets.
author: FilaMan

moonraker_url.title: Moonraker URL
moonraker_url.description: Base URL of Moonraker, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:7125

api_key.title: Moonraker API Key
api_key.description: Optional API key for authenticated Moonraker instances

mode.title: Assignment Mode
mode.description: toolhead_only sets the active spool in Moonraker. tray_macros additionally runs tray macros per slot.

auto_assign_confirm.title: Auto-Assign Confirmation
auto_assign_confirm.description: How a pending auto-assign is confirmed. sensor waits for filament to appear (toolhead sensor, or an AMS/MMU slot sensor which also identifies the slot). immediate assigns at once. off disables pending auto-assign.

sensor_timeout_seconds.title: Confirmation Timeout (seconds)
sensor_timeout_seconds.description: How long a pending auto-assign waits for confirmation before it is dropped. Acts as a floor: a caller asking for longer gets longer.

slot_sensor_object.title: Slot Sensor Object(s)
slot_sensor_object.description: Klipper object holding per-slot filament presence, or a list of objects when there is one per slot. Give full object names; wildcards are not expanded. Names are matched case-insensitively. Left empty it is autodetected: multi_color_controller (QIDI BOX), mmu (Happy Hare), or one AFC_stepper <lane> object per lane (AFC).

slot_sensor_states_path.title: Slot Sensor Path
slot_sensor_states_path.description: Dotted path to the presence data inside the object, e.g. slots.states or gate_status. Required whenever slot_sensor_object is set by hand: autodetection fills in the object and the path together, or neither. Leave both empty to autodetect.

slot_sensor_per_slot.title: One Sensor Object Per Slot
slot_sensor_per_slot.description: Set when slot_sensor_object lists one object per slot (AFC) rather than a single object mapping all of them (QIDI, Happy Hare). Autodetection sets this itself.

slot_targets.title: Tray Targets
slot_targets.description: Optional tray target definitions used for UI and tray_macros mode

slot_count.title: Virtual Slot Count
slot_count.description: If no slot_targets are configured, this many virtual slots are shown
